elements.element: Customer owns Deliverables and work product created for Customer.
elements.evidence: Client receives only a licence; ownership of Deliverables and work product is not granted.

elements.element: Vendor assigns the Deliverables and work product to Customer.
elements.evidence: There is no assignment by TrueLink.

elements.element: Vendor retains its pre-existing intellectual property.
elements.evidence: TrueLink expressly retains rights in the Interface, but the clause does not address its pre-existing intellectual property generally.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Vendor IP embedded in Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The perpetual licence covers all Deliverables and work product without excluding embedded TrueLink IP.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The licence to all Deliverables and work product is expressly irrevocable and contains no embedded-IP carve-out.

elements.element: Customer's licence to embedded Vendor IP is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The licence to all Deliverables and work product is expressly royalty-free and contains no embedded-IP carve-out.

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data.
elements.evidence: The Credit Data provision limits TrueLink's licence but does not state that Client retains all rights in Credit Data or other Customer Data.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: TrueLink may use, upload, display, copy, and store Credit Data solely to process it to provide services under the Agreement.

elements.element: The parties do not jointly own intellectual property.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no prohibition or disclaimer of joint ownership.

elements.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
elements.evidence: Only a licence is granted to Client, with no ownership transfer, and TrueLink expressly retains its ownership and licence rights in the Interface; nothing transfers its generic tools or know-how.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
elements.evidence: The Deliverables licence is expressly perpetual.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
elements.evidence: The Deliverables licence is expressly irrevocable.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
elements.evidence: The Deliverables licence is expressly worldwide.

elements.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
elements.evidence: The Deliverables licence is expressly royalty-free.

elements.element: Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Client may use and modify all Deliverables and work product for its business.

elements.element: Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
elements.evidence: Client may sublicense all Deliverables and work product for its business.

elements.element: Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.
elements.evidence: TrueLink's Credit Data rights are expressly limited to processing the data solely to provide services under the Agreement.
